_comment: Scenarios: a starting position, a set of goals and a deadline. Goals: netWorth, shops, shopsOfType {type,count}, served, franchises, topCompany, noLoans, staff. rules: noRivals, noTax, noBankruptcy, aggressiveRivals.

scenarios.name: The Corner Shop
scenarios.description: One small loan, one small shop. Turn $6,000 into a business worth $20,000 in two weeks.

scenarios.name: Borrowed Time
scenarios.description: You start $30,000 in debt with $3,000 in the bank and three weeks to clear it. Every day of interest hurts.

scenarios.name: Caffeine Empire
scenarios.description: The city runs on coffee. Open three coffee shops and serve two thousand customers within a month.

scenarios.name: Hostile Territory
scenarios.description: Three well-funded rivals already have shops in town and they play rough. Be worth more than all of them by the end of the month.

scenarios.name: Household Name
scenarios.description: Build a brand good enough that other people want to run it. Have three franchises trading and six shops of your own in five weeks.

scenarios.name: Tycoon in a Hurry
scenarios.description: Everything is unlocked and the bank is feeling generous. Reach a quarter of a million in net worth in forty days.

sandbox.name: Sandbox
sandbox.description: A million in the bank, everything unlocked, no tax and no bankruptcy. Build whatever you like.
